llm.summary: This skill is a clearly disclosed Kia Access MCP integration, but it handles vehicle location, Kia credentials, stored session tokens, and optional real vehicle commands.

dimensions.detail: Network access to Kia's Owners API, account credentials, vehicle identifiers, cached location, and physical command authority are sensitive but proportionate to the vehicle-control purpose and are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses an MCP entry with npx to run the npm package and environment variables for Kia username, password, and write mode. External package metadata and inspected files aligned with the described MCP server behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime guidance is scoped to Kia Access requests, tells the agent to list vehicles before commands, requires user confirmation for mutating commands, warns against login retries, and distinguishes dry runs from executed vehicle actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill stores a remember-me token locally for silent future login, provides a confirm-gated token export, and includes a confirm-gated forget-session tool. Persistence is sensitive but described and user-controllable.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The capability matches the stated purpose: reading Kia vehicle status/location and optionally sending climate, charging, and door commands for the user's own Kia account. These are high-impact capabilities, but the artifact discloses them plainly.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving this MCP server your Kia account credentials and access to vehicle status/location. Use KIA_WRITE_MODE=none for read-only use, comfort for climate/charging, and all only if you intentionally want door lock/unlock tools. Treat any exported rmtoken like a password and avoid putting it in chats or logs.
